# Daria Tarasova — research, product discovery and technical assessment

> Independent consultant researching complex product, technology and market questions.
> Technology and implementation research, market research, technical-claim verification and
> stakeholder interviews are turned into recommendations, solution boundaries, scope and requirements.
> Remote worldwide; works in English and Russian.

## Core service

### Decision & Discovery Sprint
A focused one-to-two-week engagement for a digital initiative that is important enough to
fund but not yet defined enough to build. Typical inputs include stakeholder interviews,
workflow analysis, market and solution research, technical review and targeted experiments.

The client receives:
- a precise decision question and problem statement;
- build / buy / change the process / do nothing options;
- a recommendation with supporting evidence;
- solution boundaries, first-version scope and prioritized requirements;
- risks, assumptions and unresolved unknowns;
- a document a delivery team or vendor can use immediately.

## Additional services
- **Technical & Market Assessment** — independent evaluation of a technology, implementation
  approach, vendor, partner, investment or emerging market against explicit criteria. Includes
  technical and market research, claim verification, comparisons and a next useful test.
- **Fractional Discovery Lead** — ongoing interviews, requirements and decision support
  between leadership, users, vendors and delivery teams. Available white-label to agencies.

## Typical clients
- CEOs, COOs and product or operations leads funding a new digital initiative;
- software and automation agencies that need senior discovery before quoting delivery;
- investors and strategy teams evaluating a company, technology, vendor or emerging theme.

## Evidence and experience
- At TVM Ventures, influenced a broader investment lens beyond one ecosystem, screened
  approximately 100 early-stage companies and conducted 15–20 structured interviews with
  payments and cross-border founders.
- Designed a benchmark for TON swap-routing solutions; a confidential comparative report
  informed jury decisions in an ecosystem competition.
- Researched the launch of a cryptocurrency exchange from jurisdiction and licensing through
  product, budget and operating plan; the company was established, licensed and launched.
- Previous work includes CTO responsibilities, system and business analysis, Solidity and
  Python development, technical documentation, AI/LLM products and academic research.

## Working principles
- Structure the research around the decision the client needs to make.
- Investigate technologies, implementation approaches, markets and stakeholder needs at the depth the question requires.
- State the reasoning, limitations and remaining risks behind a recommendation.
- End every engagement with a document the client owns: recommendation, solution boundaries, scope, requirements and next actions as relevant.
